brightport_eatloni.m: Do you not have other things to occupy yourself with. Why must you bother me?

brightport_storemaster.m: Please keep off this path, you'll get under the feet of the workers.
r: What's up with all these crates outside?
Allares sent me to help find the apple delivery.

brightport_storemaster1.m: I am Eatloni the storemaster. My brother Allares and I handle the storage and delivery of the bakery's goods.
r: Is there any work for me to do here?

brightport_storemaster10.m: In total 30. That should be enough for the first round of baking. If you wouldn't mind giving them to me.
r: Here you go. [Hand over the apples.]
I think I might have eaten some.

brightport_storemaster11.m: Thank you $playername, that is excellent. Head inside and tell my brother the apples will be brought inside soon. As for your remuneration, he will reward you sufficiently.

brightport_storemaster12.m: So? He hasn't delivered them. If you went through the trouble of going there you could have at least obtained a new batch of 30 apples.
r: But you didn't tell me to...

brightport_storemaster2.m: Our bakery bakes the finest bread in all of Dhayavar. There's bound to be a bit of a jumble getting it onto the rich folk's tables.
r: Is there any work for me to do here?

brightport_storemaster3.m: You're better off asking my brother Allares, you can find him in the bakery. Either way, they sure do make you youngsters work hard these days.

brightport_storemaster4.m: Yes, it's unusual that it hasn't arrived. According to the contract, the merchant I hired will only get half pay for being late, that is if they even arrive.

brightport_storemaster5.m: But it's not about the gold this time, we need them for an order and we can't be late ourselves. It would be nice if you could visit Deebo's Orchard south of the Duleian Road to see if the order of thirty apples has been picked up.

brightport_storemaster6.m: Thank you, $playername, that's excellent. However, I haven't contacted the merchant's Guild for a reimbursement yet, so I can't repay you in full. I can only offer you half the price. Once you hand over the 30 apples.
r: Here you go. [Hand over the apples.]
I think I might have eaten some.

brightport_storemaster7.m: Here you go, that's 700 gold, now go inside and tell my brother the apples will be coming soon, I just need to write them in my ledger.

brightport_storemaster8.m: That's not good. I need all 30, if you don't have them then I can't repay you.

brightport_storemaster9.m: The merchant arrived safe and sound shortly before you did. Well not quite, apparently he got robbed by highwaymen, and had to run for it with nothing but his cloak and a sack of 15 apples.

brightport_storemaster_apples.m: Have you learned what happened with the apple delivery?
r: I have the shipment from Deebo.
Apparantly the merchant picked them up.
I found the apples in a mountain cat nest. The poor merchant probably got eaten.

brightport_bakery.1: I've started some work for Allares at the bakery in Brightport. He asked me to help Delon down in the storage area.
brightport_bakery.5: I spoke with Delon and he's a real slacker. He wants me to do all sorts of work, all by myself.
brightport_bakery.10: He told me to start by sweeping the floor, and to do that I must find a broom.
brightport_bakery.15: The floor's all swept. I did it all by myself. Delon's "help" was more of a nuisance.
brightport_bakery.16: No wonder it got so quiet. Delon disappeared to sleep on some sacks. And now I have a new task, to sift through some flour.
brightport_bakery.19: I've sifted through all of the flour.
brightport_bakery.20: One last errand. An apple delivery hasn't arrived. I should ask Allares about it.
brightport_bakery.22: Allares refuses to accept my help until I prove my capabilities by bringing him one piece of deer meat.
brightport_bakery.23: After bringing the deer meat to Allares, he accepted my help, I should speak to Eatloni outside.
brightport_bakery.25: According to Eatloni, the order of 30 apples never arrived. I should visit Deebo's Orchard to check if the order had been picked up.
brightport_bakery.30: I went to see Deebo at the orchard. Apparently the merchant sent by Eatloni already picked up the apples.
brightport_bakery.35: I found some half-eaten apples in the woods north of the Duleian road.
brightport_bakery.40: I found two crates of apples. One was intact, but the other was empty. Did the mountain cats attack the merchant for food to feed their cubs?
brightport_bakery.45: I paid for a new shipment out of my own pocket. Deebo promised to hurry his workers and get them picked quickly. I should receive them from the orchard supervisor.
brightport_bakery.50: I received the apples from Alduan.
brightport_bakery.60: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. He reimbursed me for half the cost. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.65: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.70: I completed all the tasks at the bakery.
